sum_insured_options: ₹1L – ₹600L (various options mentioned in health check-up table)

room_rent.display: Single Private Room or 1% of SI/day
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies either Single Private Room or up to 1% of SI per day. Room Rent Modification (Optional Benefit 5) removes the cap entirely for SI ≥ ₹5L.

icu.note: Policy Schedule specifies either up to 2% of SI per day or no sub-limit on ICU charges. No sub-limit option available inbuilt depending on plan chosen.

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay per claim for Insured Persons aged 61 years or above at first policy issuance. Existing customers insured before age 61 have option of 20% co-pay with adjusted premium. Optional Co-Payment benefit also available. Global Coverage has additional mandatory 10% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits; room rent & ICU capped per plan
sub_limits.note: Room rent and ICU charges are sub-limited per Policy Schedule (Single Private Room or 1% SI/day; ICU 2% SI/day). No disease-wise monetary sub-limits explicitly stated beyond room/ICU. Optional Benefit 5 removes room/ICU caps.

deductible.note: Deductible is an optional benefit (Optional Benefit 1); no mandatory deductible in base plan. Aggregate deductible applies across all claims in a policy year if opted.

initial_waiting.note: Expenses for any illness within 90 days from first policy commencement date are excluded, except claims due to accident.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 36 months. Reducible to 24 months via Optional Benefit 8 (Reduction of PED Wait Period), available only at inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific named ailment waiting period of 24 months applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT surgeries, BPH, varicose veins, etc. (applicable only for Operation Mediclaim plan).

maternity.note: Maternity is listed as a permanent exclusion (Code Excl18). Childbirth, complicated deliveries, C-sections, and lawful termination of pregnancy are excluded.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% at end of 1st claim-free year, 25% at end of 2nd, 25% at end of 3rd, capped at 100% of SI. Reduced by same rate on claim. Option to take NCB as premium discount instead.

restoration.note: Optional Benefit 3: Unlimited Automatic Recharge reinstates up to SI unlimited times per year, but only for claims not related to any illness/injury for which a claim has already been admitted that year. Available for SI >₹1L and ≤₹50L. Entirely optional add-on.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission, for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 60 days after discharge, for the same condition.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered for procedures listed in Annexure I (extensive list of 540+ procedures). List varies by plan opted.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available in hospital.

ayush.note: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Siddha, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Homeopathy) in-patient treatment covered up to Sum Insured at registered AYUSH hospitals, linked to an admitted hospitalisation claim.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor medical expenses covered up to limit specified in Policy Schedule, linked to an admitted hospitalisation claim for the recipient.

ambulance.display: Up to limit in Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to amount specified in Policy Schedule. Air Ambulance is a separate Optional Benefit 7.

modern_treatments.note: Advanced technology methods covered include robotic surgeries, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, HIFU, immunotherapy injections, intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions. Other advance technology methods excluded.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are excluded. No optional rider for consumables mentioned.

global_cover.note: Benefit 12 (Global Coverage) covers hospitalisation outside India up to SI, available only if SI ≥ ₹100L, for 45 days per trip / 90 days cumulative per year. Mandatory 10% co-pay applies. Inpatient and day care only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Applies separately to enhanced SI from date of enhancement.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all payment modes except monthly (15 days). Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Free look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, STDs (non-HIV), external congenital anomalies, mental retardation, sleep disorder devices, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, non-listed advance tech methods

optional_riders.display: Deductible, Co-pay option, Unlimited Recharge, Intl Second Opinion, Room Rent Modification, Accidental SI top-up, Air Ambulance, PED wait reduction to 24mo
